label: Terrain dock panel open
verdict:
**QA Review — Backyard Designer 3D**

**(1) Overlapping / clipped UI**
- ⚠️ **"Patio" list item clipped** — the last item in the left sidebar is cut mid-row by the status bar; its thumbnail/description is unreadable. Looks broken rather than intentionally scrollable (no scroll affordance visible).
- ⚠️ **Stray glyph in the "Terrain Controls" panel** — the small "⊟"-style icon at the panel's top-right floats detached from any label; reads as clipped debris or a mis-anchored collapse button.
- Minor: the "Daytime" pill at top-center of the canvas looks like a detached tooltip (no visible control it belongs to).
- No hard panel-to-panel overlaps: the left SCULPT rail, center Terrain Sculpting dialog, and bottom toolbar all clear each other by ~10px.

**(2) 5-second comprehension for a new user**
- Mostly yes: "Getting Started" tip, active-tool chip ("Tool: Raise"), and the highlighted Terrain button give good anchors. However, the screen is **very busy** — three separate tool surfaces (left rail, center dialog, bottom toolbar) all active simultaneously, and it's not obvious which one has focus. The center dialog dominating the viewport also hides the thing you're supposed to be sculpting.

**(3) Confusing / ambiguous / broken-looking**
- **"Innovate"** button label is vague — unclear what it does among Tape Measure / Excavate / Analyze.
- **"FPS: —"** in the status bar suggests the stats readout isn't wired up or hasn't loaded.
- **Brush Size / Strength** labels sit tight against the slider track; the values (8 ft / 0.05) are far right, weakening label–value association. Minor.
- "GRID LEVEL & DEPTH ▾", "CARVING ▾", "PRESETS & TOOLS ▾" as full-width text-chip dropdowns look like labels, not buttons — low affordance.
- Mode buttons wrap to two rows (Raise/Lower/Smooth/Erode + Flatten/Dig/Fill) — functional but reads as two unrelated groups at a glance.

**Verdict:** Not CLEAN — one clipped sidebar item ("Patio"), one stray/misplaced icon in the Terrain Controls panel, plus minor polish items (Daytime pill placement, FPS readout, "Innovate" labeling). Fix the clipping and stray glyph before ship; the rest is nitpicking.
